description: This file contains utility functions for JSON message handling, including sending and receiving JSON messages over a socket, and converting between string representations and enum types for request types, interface types, and request statuses. It also defines constants for versioning and maps for string-enum conversions.

methods.name: SendJsonMsg
methods.description: Sends a JSON message over a socket, including a header with message length and version.

methods.name: RecvJsonMsg
methods.description: Receives a JSON message over a socket, validating header version and parsing payload.

methods.name: ReqTyToStr
methods.description: Converts a RequestType enum to its string representation.

methods.name: StrToReqTy
methods.description: Converts a string to its corresponding RequestType enum.

methods.name: StatusToStr
methods.description: Converts a RequestStatus enum to its string representation.

methods.name: StrToStatus
methods.description: Converts a string to its corresponding RequestStatus enum.

methods.name: IfaceTyToStr
methods.description: Converts an IfaceType enum to its string representation.

methods.name: StrToIfaceTy
methods.description: Converts a string to its corresponding IfaceType enum.
